category_title: Primary students with low reading motivation who perceive a lack of autonomy and environmental discomfort
scenario_title: Environmental discomfort and instructional interruptions during reading
minimal_context: The student is participating in an independent reading task in a pullout reading intervention room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started with our independent reading. Please sit in your regular chair and begin your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This chair is uncomfortable. I would prefer to spend more time reading in the comfy blue chair. And it's a little bit noisier in here than my classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just sit there for today and try to focus on your reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's harder to read in here. The school should install an insulated pod in this room so I can have a quiet place to read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, please stop reading your book now so we can do spelling and sounds.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My classroom teacher doesn’t stop us when we’re reading to do spelling or to do sounds and stuff. I don't get to make much decisions in here.
